You must be at least 13 years old and able to enter into a contract where you live. One account per person. You are responsible for what happens under your account, so keep your sign-in details to yourself.

2. What Nia does — and what it is not

Nia is a mobile app for a nightly manifestation ritual: you write a short scene of something you want as if it has already happened, and listen to it narrated — by a preset voice or, if you choose, a copy of your own — as you fall asleep.

A ritual, not a treatment or a promise. Nia is for relaxation and reflection. It is not a medical device, it does not diagnose, treat or prevent any sleep, mental-health or other condition, and it is not a substitute for professional care. Manifestation is a personal practice: we make no promise that anything you visualise, write or listen to will happen, and every decision you make is your own.

Scene drafts, affirmations, song lyrics, songs, daily texts and narration are produced with AI models from what you give them. They can be imperfect; you can edit, re-generate or replace much of it, and you decide what to keep. The daily texts are written by AI in the style of people you describe; they are not messages from those people.

Listen only when it is safe to become drowsy — never while driving or operating machinery.

If anything it generates is offensive or plainly wrong, email hello@fluxternal.com so we can look at it.
